Default.aTrickTakingGame: A trick-taking game of bold claims. Win the EXACT target number of tricks, or ZERO — anything else scores nothing. Watch the shifting suit strengths and use your Pass cards wisely!
Default.whoNeedsTheTutorial: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.braggartIsATrick:
Braggart is a trick-taking game for 3-5 players with three suits: Brains, Speed, and Strength (1-11).

Each round you get 7 cards. Follow the led suit if you can!
Default.theThreeSuitsHave:
The three suits have a shifting strength order shown in the middle (Strongest / Middle / Weakest). ANY card of a stronger suit beats ANY card of a weaker one; numbers only break ties within a suit.

After each trick, the winning suit drops to Weakest! Play a Pass card to duck a trick — it never wins.
Default.goBigOrGo:
Go big or go home: score 2 pts for winning ZERO tricks, or 1 pt for winning EXACTLY the target (3 tricks @3p, 2 @4p, 1 @5p). Anything else = 0.

Vote to keep playing; most points when you stop wins!
